infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kudya uses your location to show nearby restaurants, services, properties, doctors, and deliveries, and to help with rides and package pickup.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Kudya uses your location to show nearby services and to support active deliveries and rides while you use the app.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kudya needs photo library access so you can upload profile photos and documents.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kudya needs camera access so you can take profile photos and upload documents.
